findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 仍描述通路為直銷團隊＋經銷商，同時直接與間接售予模組廠、OEM 與超大規模業者；未見通路或商業模式結構性改變的敘述。
findings.excerpt: We sell memory interface chips directly and indirectly to memory module manufacturers, OEMs and hyperscalers worldwide through multiple channels, including our direct sales force and distributors, and we employ global sales personnel to support such operations.

findings.claim: Q3 2026 營收組合：產品收入 $114.3M、權利金 $77.0M、合約及其他 $27.0M（權利金占比下降、產品占比上升）。
findings.excerpt: Total revenue for the third quarter was $218.3 million, product revenue was $114.3 million, royalties revenue was $77.0 million and contract and other revenue was $27.0 million.

note: 搜尋未找到 2026 年通路破壞、訂閱化、D2C 或 go-to-market 變更的來源。搜尋摘要僅顯示收入組合由權利金轉向產品（Q3 2026 產品 $114.3M、權利金 $77.0M），但無可逐字複製的原文，不列為 finding。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
